DAY_RULE_wind_D: Gusts sweep across the whole map, wind zones are stronger.

DAY_RULE_tailwind_D: Only 60 % gravity and light gusts: the taxi floats and drifts.

DAY_GOAL_precision_D: As many perfect landings as possible.

HELP_BUG: Found a bug? Report it by e-mail – with system details and the log folder.
BUG_TEXT: Something not working? Write to %s. “Write e-mail” opens your mail program with subject and system details filled in. Attaching godot.log from the log folder helps a lot.
BUG_MAIL_FAILED: No mail program found – please write to %s.
BUG_MAIL_Q2: What were you doing? (mode, level, last actions)
WATCH_HINT: Replaying your best run · %s: back to level select
OPT_ACCESS_NOTE: Colour-blind mode: lights, fuel, fuel price and lamps in blue, yellow and crimson instead of green, yellow and red. Large text: HUD, subtitles, flight school and clips. Mono: both ears hear the same sound.
HELP_DEBUG3D: Comparison: taxi in levels as the hybrid (default, “3D”) or as the previous 2D pixel art. In a level, F6 switches directly.
HELP_UPDATE: A new version is out – opens the project page on itch.io.
UPDATE_ASK_SUB: Once a day at most, GraviFare can ask GitHub whether a new version is out and let you know in the main menu. No personal data is sent. You can change this at any time under Options › Game.
HELP_DEBUGEGGS: Debug: view and force all easter eggs.
ACH_DAY_NIKOLAUS_D: Played on St. Nicholas' Day (6 December)
ACH_DAY_SILVESTER_D: Played on New Year's Eve (31 December)

OT_SEED_D: Same seed, length and license: same crossings and offers. Six characters, to share with others.
OT_STAGE_0_D: No extra hardship. Every completed run unlocks the next overtime level.

OT_STAGE_3: one taxi less at the start
OT_STAGE_7: risky jobs get one more incident
OT_STAGE_9: one part less at the pit stop
OT_START_SURE: Replace the current run? Press again
OT_START_D: %d taxis, ¢%d starting money. Your career stays untouched; achievements and stats don’t count here.

OT_PACT_D: Pact: %s stays until the run ends.
OT_CALM_D: A calm job: no incidents, normal pay.
OT_FIN_CHART: Height: stage points · number: incidents · colour: green none, yellow one, red two, purple three or more.
MSG_OT_ANGEL: Guardian angel! One hull point left
MSG_OT_PICKY: %s won’t pay after that hard landing!
OT_PERK_QUICKGEAR_D: Landing gear moves a third faster.
OT_PERK_GREEDY_D: Main thrust +10 %, but 25 % more fuel use.
OT_PERK_RESERVE_D: Once per stage a reserve tank with 15 % kicks in when you run dry.
OT_PERK_BUMPER_D: Bumps stay harmless up to 6 px/s faster, per level.
OT_PERK_SPIKEGUARD_D: The first spike touch per level is free.
OT_PERK_HEATSHIELD_D: Lava, heat and plasma beams do 40 % less damage.
OT_PERK_RAM_D: Debris, traffic and meteors do 30 % less damage.
OT_PERK_SELFREPAIR_D: While landed the hull repairs 2 points per second.
OT_PERK_CHEAPREPAIR_D: Repairs at the end of a level 40 % cheaper.
OT_PERK_SOFTGEAR_D: Allowed sink rate +3 px/s per level.
OT_PERK_STRUT_D: Hard landings cost only half as much of the fare.
OT_PERK_SKIDS_D: When landing the taxi may move 8 px/s faster sideways.
OT_PERK_VELVET_D: Perfect landings count up to 4 px/s faster.
OT_PERK_CHARMER_D: Up to 5 tips per ride, each 50 % higher.
OT_PERK_METER_D: Fast rides pay more: time bonus up to ×1.6 instead of ×1.4.
OT_PERK_BRISK_D: The walk to the shelter only counts half.
OT_PERK_SEAT_D: In a crash the passenger survives and waits at their platform again.
OT_PERK_INSURANCE_D: Replacement taxis after a crash are free.
OT_PERK_ANGEL_D: Once: instead of being destroyed, the taxi survives with one hull point.
OT_PERK_SCANNER_D: One more job to choose from at every crossing.
OT_PERK_DICE_D: Two dice: reroll a crossing or pit stop for free.
OT_PERK_CHARM_D: Rare and legendary parts show up twice as often per level.
OT_PERK_BRIBE_D: Once per crossing, drop an incident for credits.
OT_PERK_HAGGLE_D: Parts at pit stops 15 % cheaper per level.
OT_PERK_SALARY_D: At the start of each stage 100 credits per level, 25 % more per sector.
OT_PERK_DOUBLE_D: One more extra passenger waits at the same time.
OT_PERK_CHAIN_D: Your perfect-landing streak carries over stages and its bonus counts double.
OT_PERK_RISK_D: Double hazard pay for every incident.
OT_PERK_INTEREST_D: 6 % interest on your balance at every pit stop (at most 600).
OT_PERK_ACE_D: Stage score bonuses (time, clean, pro, landings) count 50 % more.
OT_CURSE_HOTJET_D: After 1.5 s of full thrust the main jet overheats and gives only 60 % until it cools. The strip under the taxi shows heat and cooling.
OT_CURSE_STICKYGEAR_D: The landing gear takes eight times as long.
OT_CURSE_CROOKED_D: One side jet has only 60 % power.
OT_CURSE_LEAK_D: Fuel drains noticeably, even while parked (almost half a percent per second).
OT_CURSE_HEAVY_D: 12 % less thrust with a passenger on board.
OT_CURSE_SLICK_D: Only a quarter of the damping: the taxi keeps sliding long after every manoeuvre.
OT_CURSE_NOLIGHT_D: No landing light and no landing assist: land by feel.
OT_CURSE_NORADIO_D: No target marker: the destination is only in the announcement.
OT_CURSE_SHAKY_D: Fuel and hull gauges swing slowly and widely, the fuel alarm stays silent.
OT_CURSE_NEWROUTE_D: Dispatch hands out different rides than usual on this map.
OT_CURSE_PUMPCYCLE_D: The fuel pump is open only 6 out of 12 seconds; the light above it shows when.
OT_CURSE_PICKY_D: After a hard landing at drop-off the passenger pays nothing.
OT_CURSE_CASH_D: Earnings arrive only at the end of the level; a crash loses the whole cash box.
OT_CURSE_AUDIT_D: After the stage 15 % of your balance above 500 goes to the tax office.
OT_CURSE_PARTS_D: Repairs at the end of a level cost double.
OT_CURSE_SPARELESS_D: Replacement taxis after a crash cost triple.
OT_LIC_SAVER_D: Starts with fuel saver and discount card, but fares 5 % lower.
OT_LIC_RACER_D: Starts with turbo jet and fine control, but 10 % more impact damage.
OT_LIC_TANK_D: Starts with two levels of armour plates, but 10 % more fuel use.
OT_LIC_CHARMER_D: Starts with charmer and regulars, but passengers 10 % less patient.
OT_LIC_GAMBLER_D: Starts with dice cup and lucky charm, but one taxi less.
